title: 第2章  背叛楚家的人，都得死！
content_zh:
虽然楚枫恢复了修为，可被赵雪莲折磨了这么久，他看上去透着病态的消瘦之感。
曾经那个意气风发的少年竟然变成了这般模样，赵有容莫名心中一痛。
“对不起，我、我想要帮你，可是我没有了灵根，一直被锁在这……”
她挣扎着想站起来，可跪坐太久，双腿早已麻木，身子一晃险些跌倒在地。
楚枫立刻扶住她，指尖拂开她颊边脏污的发丝。
“从今往后，没人能再锁着你了。”
就在这时，灵池传来扑通巨响。
池心水面上漂浮着一朵雪莲，那雪莲根茎隐在灵池深处，露出水面的花茎顶着一朵碗口大的花苞。
而此时赵雪莲已经扑入灵池之中，双手捧着天泉雪莲，微微扬起了下巴。
她之所以带楚枫来灵池，就是为了找机会将天泉雪莲掌握在自己手里。
没想到，楚枫一进门竟然先放了赵有容那个废物，这就给了她足够的机会。
“你别过来啊！”
楚枫转头看向灵池之中的赵雪莲，他之所以带赵雪莲来，就是想要借助灵池之中的力量，彻底吞噬她体内的修为。
没想到，这个蠢女人竟然想要用天泉雪莲威胁他。
看着楚枫的脸色越发阴沉，赵雪莲眼中闪过一丝报复的快感。
现在她只能用这朵天泉雪莲让楚枫投鼠忌器，才能想办法脱身。
“三皇子已经知道了天泉雪莲成熟，你若敢再往前半步，我就当场捏碎它。
到时候整个楚家都要为这朵雪莲陪葬，被三皇子屠得鸡犬不留！”
赵雪莲自认为胜券在握，一脸鄙夷地盯着楚枫。
“你要是识相，现在就自废修为，像狗一样跪在我面前。

我或许还能大发慈悲，让你留在我身边，让你亲眼看着我被三皇子宠幸。”
话音刚落，异变陡生！
赵雪莲眼前突然闪过一道残影，楚枫竟瞬间跨越一丈距离，出现在灵池中央。
“你竟然突破到了炼气五重！”
还没等她反应过来，手腕就被楚枫死死攥住，那力道几乎要捏碎她的骨头。
楚枫另一只手捏住她的下巴，强迫她张开嘴，将那朵还带着池水湿气的天泉雪莲，全部塞进了她的嘴里。
“我最讨厌别人威胁我。”
“唔——”
赵雪莲瞪大眼睛，喉咙里发出呜咽之声。
天泉雪莲刚入喉，就化作一股磅礴到恐怖的灵气涌入体内。
她的腹部就以肉眼可见的速度隆起，原本平坦的小腹鼓得像怀胎十月的孕妇。
“好疼……快救我，我要被撑爆了！”
楚枫运转炼天图，让天泉雪莲和赵雪莲的丹田融合，她浑身的精血也涌入腹部丹田之中，形成了一枚血丹。
“今天我就让你知道什么是真正的炉鼎。”
他抬手放在了赵雪莲隆起的腹部，开始疯狂榨取血丹的力量。
“楚枫，你毁了灵药，三皇子一定会把你千刀万剐！”
赵雪莲后悔了，她后悔带楚枫来灵池了。
现在天泉雪莲被毁，不仅楚枫要死，就连赵家都要承受三皇子的怒火。
源源不断的灵力涌入楚枫体内，炼气六重、炼气七重、炼气八重、炼气九重！
他丹田之中积聚的灵力越发浑厚，很快便达到了圆满之境。

一道金色光柱从天而降，笼罩住了楚枫周身，海量的天地之力涌入他的体内。
“这是……炼气至极境！”
每一个大境界都有十重小境界，第十重境界为至极境。
但是想要达到此境界，需要海量灵气灌入体内，将境界夯实到极致。
此刻，他举手投足之间便可调动天地之力。
暖阁内的灵池水汽渐散，赵雪莲像一摊烂泥般瘫在池边青石板上。
她脸色惨白如纸，原本丰腴的身段以肉眼可见的干瘪下去。
隆起的腹部早已平复，可丹田处空荡荡的剧痛却如附骨之疽。
楚枫不仅榨干了天泉雪莲的药力，还吸走了她大半精血。
经脉寸寸断裂如乱麻，灵根更是被彻底碾碎。
“我是王妃，你竟敢毁了我的身子！”
楚枫从灵池走出，他弯腰拎起赵雪莲的后颈，扔到了暖阁门口。
而后捡起地上的锁链，强行套在了赵雪莲的脖子上。
“从今以后，你在我面前只能爬，敢站起来，我打断你的腿。”
赵雪莲不断撕扯自己脖子上的颈圈，尖叫道。
“你竟然想让我做你的狗，你这个浑蛋！”
然而，这是她专门给赵有容打造的灵器，没有修为根本无法挣脱。
没想到天道轮回，最终会拴在自己的脖子上。
赵有容紧抿着唇，泪水从脸颊滑落，她知道楚枫这是在替她出气。
曾经的楚枫那般疼爱赵雪莲，如今竟然为了她，弃之如敝屣。

此刻，她的心好似被什么东西狠狠撞了一下。
就在此时，院外突然传来一阵急促的脚步声。
赵雪莲似乎想到了什么，她也不挣扎了，甚至直接笑出了声。
“这暖阁之中布置了阵法，一旦天泉雪莲被毁，我哥便会知晓。
楚枫，你跑不掉了！”
赵雪莲直接站起身来，冷冷地盯着楚枫。
“现在就算你跪下来求我也没有用了，我要把你的手脚都砍下来做成人彘。”
“谁允许你站起来的？”
楚枫眼神一冷，抬脚便踹在她右腿膝盖上。
只听咔嚓一声脆响，赵雪莲瞬间惨叫出声，膝盖以诡异的角度弯折，整个人瘫跪在地，冷汗顺着鬓角疯狂滚落。
楚枫拉着手中的锁链，将赵雪莲直接拖出了暖阁。
“我会让你亲眼看着，所有背叛楚家的人，都得死。”
话音刚落，院外便传来一阵嘈杂的脚步声，十几道身影闯入院中，为首的正是赵家嫡子赵德柱。
见到眼前这一幕，赵德柱顿时怒发冲冠，楚枫竟然敢把他妹妹当狗一样牵着。
“楚枫，你找死！”
“哥，快杀了他！”赵雪莲趴在地上，指着楚枫疯狂嘶吼，“他毁了天泉雪莲，不杀他，三皇子会让所有人陪葬！”
“天泉雪莲没了？”
赵德柱脸色骤变，看向灵池的目光满是惊怒之色。
“没想到留你一命反而成了祸害，给我杀了他！”
张供奉扫了楚枫一眼，讥讽道。

“楚枫啊楚枫，你爹死了才三年，你就忘了自己是什么货色了，一个废人也敢动大小姐？”
李供奉扛着斧头往前走了两步，冷声道。
“识相点就自己磕断双腿赔罪，现在楚家早姓赵了，你就是条没人要的野狗。”
院中的护卫也跟着哄笑起来，在他们眼里，楚枫就是个被赵雪莲榨干修为的废物。
任何一个人随便动动手指头，都能把楚枫碾死。
大小姐之所以被楚枫所制，定然是在突破筑基之时被楚枫暗算了。
张供奉和李供奉对视一眼，两人都是筑基三重的修为，对付一个废人，简直是杀鸡用牛刀。
“楚枫，别怪我们心狠，要怪就怪你自己不识时务。”
两人同时出手，院中人都抱着看戏的心态，可下一秒，所有人的笑容都僵在了脸上。
“当年你走火入魔，我爹耗三万灵石救你一命，你就是这么报答楚家？”
楚枫身形骤然一动，原地只剩一道残影。
张供奉的灵力掌还没碰到他的衣角，他已经出现在张供奉面前，手肘狠狠撞在张供奉胸口。
“咔嚓！”
肋骨断裂的脆响清晰可闻，张供奉喷出一口鲜血，身体像断线的风筝般飞出去，砸在墙上后滑落在地，抽搐两下便没了气息。
content_en:
Although Chu Feng had recovered his cultivation, he looked sickly and emaciated after being tortured by Zhao Xuelian for so long.
The once high-spirited young man turned into this, and Zhao Yourong felt inexplicably sad.
"I'm sorry, I, I wanted to help you, but I don't have my spiritual roots and I've been locked here..."
She struggled to stand up, but after sitting on her knees for too long, her legs were already numb, and she almost fell to the ground when her body swayed.
Chu Feng immediately supported her and brushed away the dirty hair on her cheek with his fingertips.
"From now on, no one can lock you up anymore."
At this moment, there was a loud thud from the spirit pool.
There is a snow lotus floating on the water in the center of the pool. The rhizome of the snow lotus is hidden in the depths of the spiritual pool, and the flower stem exposed above the water holds a bud as big as the mouth of a bowl.
At this time, Zhao Xuelian had already jumped into the spiritual pond, holding the Tianquan Snow Lotus in both hands, and raised her chin slightly.
The reason why she brought Chu Feng to Lingchi was to find an opportunity to take Tianquan Snow Lotus into her own hands.
Unexpectedly, Chu Feng let that good-for-nothing Zhao Yourong go first as soon as he entered the door, which gave her enough opportunities.
"Don't come over here!"
Chu Feng turned to look at Zhao Xuelian in the spiritual pool. The reason why he brought Zhao Xuelian here was to use the power in the spiritual pool to completely devour the cultivation in her body.
Unexpectedly, this stupid woman actually wanted to threaten him with Tianquan Snow Lotus.
Seeing Chu Feng's face becoming more and more gloomy, a trace of revenge flashed in Zhao Xuelian's eyes.
Now she can only use this Tianquan Snow Lotus to make Chu Feng throw a rat weapon in order to find a way to escape.
"The Third Prince already knows that Tianquan Snow Lotus is mature. If you dare to take another step forward, I will crush it on the spot.
When the time comes, the entire Chu family will be buried with this snow lotus, and will be slaughtered by the third prince until no one is left alive! "
Zhao Xuelian thought she was sure of victory and stared at Chu Feng with disdain.
"If you know what I'm doing, you can destroy your cultivation right now and kneel in front of me like a dog.
Maybe I can show mercy and let you stay by my side, so that you can see me being favored by the third prince with your own eyes. "
As soon as he finished speaking, a sudden change occurred!
An afterimage suddenly flashed before Zhao Xuelian's eyes, and Chu Feng suddenly crossed a distance of ten feet and appeared in the center of the spirit pool.
"You actually broke through to the fifth level of Qi refining!"
Before she could react, Chu Feng grabbed her wrist tightly, with such force that it almost crushed her bones.
Chu Feng pinched her chin with his other hand, forced her to open her mouth, and stuffed the Tianquan Snow Lotus that was still moist from the pond water into her mouth.
"I hate it when people threaten me."
"Uh-"
Zhao Xuelian's eyes widened and a whimper came out of her throat.
As soon as Tianquan Snow Lotus entered the throat, it turned into a majestic and terrifying spiritual energy and poured into the body.
Her abdomen swelled at a speed visible to the naked eye, and her originally flat belly bulged like a pregnant woman who was ten months pregnant.
"It hurts...help me quickly, I'm going to burst!"
Chu Feng circulated the Heaven Refining Diagram to fuse Tianquan Snow Lotus and Zhao Xuelian's dantian. The essence and blood from her body also poured into the dantian of her abdomen, forming a blood pill.
"Today I will let you know what a real furnace is."
He raised his hand and placed it on Zhao Xuelian's bulging abdomen, and began to frantically squeeze out the power of the blood pill.
"Chu Feng, if you ruin the elixir, the Third Prince will definitely cut you into pieces!"
Zhao Xuelian regretted, she regretted bringing Chu Feng to Lingchi.
Now that Tianquan Snow Lotus is destroyed, not only Chu Feng will die, but even the Zhao family will have to bear the wrath of the third prince.
A steady stream of spiritual power poured into Chu Feng's body, at the sixth level of Qi refining, the seventh level of Qi refining, the eighth level of Qi refining, and the ninth level of Qi refining!
The spiritual power accumulated in his Dantian became stronger and stronger, and he soon reached the state of perfection.
A golden beam of light fell from the sky and enveloped Chu Feng, and a massive amount of power from heaven and earth poured into his body.
"This is...the ultimate state of qi refining!"
Every major realm has ten smaller realms, and the tenth realm is the ultimate realm.
But to reach this state, you need a lot of spiritual energyThe Qi is poured into the body, consolidating the realm to the extreme.
At this moment, he can mobilize the power of heaven and earth with just a few movements of his hands.
The water vapor in the spiritual pool in Nuan Pavilion gradually dissipated, and Zhao Xuelian collapsed on the bluestone beside the pool like a puddle of mud.
Her face was as pale as paper, and her originally plump figure shriveled up visibly to the naked eye.
The bulging abdomen has long since subsided, but the sharp pain in the dantian is like a gangrene attached to the bone.
Chu Feng not only squeezed out the medicinal power of Tianquan Snow Lotus, but also sucked away most of her blood essence.
The meridians were broken and tangled, and the spiritual roots were completely crushed.
"I am the princess, how dare you destroy my body!"
Chu Feng walked out of the Lingchi. He bent down and picked up the back of Zhao Xuelian's neck and threw it to the door of Nuan Pavilion.
Then he picked up the chain on the ground and forced it around Zhao Xuelian's neck.
"From now on, you can only crawl in front of me. If you dare to stand up, I will break your legs."
Zhao Xuelian kept tearing the collar around her neck and screamed.
"You actually want me to be your dog, you bastard!"
However, this was a spiritual weapon she specially created for Zhao Yourong, and it was impossible to break free without cultivation.
Unexpectedly, the reincarnation of heaven would eventually be tied around his neck.
Zhao Yourong pursed her lips tightly and tears fell from her cheeks. She knew that Chu Feng was venting his anger on her behalf.
Chu Feng once loved Zhao Xuelian so much, but now he abandoned him like a piece of shit for her.
At this moment, her heart seemed to be hit hard by something.
At this moment, there was a sudden rush of footsteps outside the hospital.
Zhao Xuelian seemed to have thought of something, and she stopped struggling and even laughed out loud.
"There is a formation in this Nuan Pavilion. Once the Tianquan Snow Lotus is destroyed, my brother will know about it.
Chu Feng, you can't run away! "
Zhao Xuelian stood up directly and stared at Chu Feng coldly.
"It's no use even if you kneel down and beg me now. I'm going to chop off your hands and feet and make them into human pigs."
"Who gave you permission to stand up?"
Chu Feng's eyes turned cold, and he raised his foot and kicked her right knee.
There was just a crisp sound, and Zhao Xuelian screamed instantly, her knees bent at a weird angle, and she collapsed on the ground, cold sweat rolling down her temples crazily.
Chu Feng pulled the chain in his hand and dragged Zhao Xuelian directly out of Nuan Pavilion.
"I will let you see with your own eyes that everyone who betrayed the Chu family will die."
As soon as he finished speaking, there was a burst of noisy footsteps outside the courtyard, and more than a dozen figures broke into the courtyard. The leader was Zhao Dezhu, the legitimate son of the Zhao family.
Seeing this scene before him, Zhao Dezhu was immediately furious. Chu Feng actually dared to lead his sister like a dog.
"Chu Feng, you are looking for death!"
"Brother, kill him quickly!" Zhao Xuelian lay on the ground, pointed at Chu Feng and screamed wildly, "He destroyed Tianquan Xuelian. If you don't kill him, the third prince will let everyone be buried with him!"
"Tianquan Snow Lotus is gone?"
Zhao Dezhu's expression suddenly changed, and his eyes towards Lingchi were full of shock and anger.
"I didn't expect that keeping you alive would turn out to be a disaster. Kill him!"
Zhang Gongfeng glanced at Chu Feng and said sarcastically.
"Chu Feng, Chu Feng, it has only been three years since your father died, and you have already forgotten who you are. How dare a useless person touch the eldest lady?"
Li Gongfeng took two steps forward carrying the ax and said coldly.
"If you know better, break your legs to make amends. Now that the Chu family has already been named Zhao, you are just a wild dog that no one wants."
The guards in the courtyard also burst into laughter. In their eyes, Chu Feng was just a waste who had been drained of his cultivation by Zhao Xuelian.
Anyone can crush Chu Feng to death with just a move of their fingers.
The reason why the eldest lady was controlled by Chu Feng must be because she was plotted by Chu Feng when she broke through the foundation building.
Zhang Gongfeng and Li Gongfeng looked at each other. Both of them were at the third level of foundation building. To deal with a useless person, it was simply killing a chicken with a sledgehammer.
"Chu Feng, don't blame us for being cruel. If you want to blame us, blame yourself for being ignorant of current affairs."
The two of them took action at the same time, and everyone in the courtyard had the mentality of watching a show, but the next second, everyoneEveryone's smiles froze on their faces.
"When you went crazy, my father spent 30,000 spirit stones to save your life. Is this how you repay the Chu family?"
Chu Feng's figure suddenly moved, leaving only an afterimage on the spot.
Before Zhang Chongfeng's spiritual palm touched the corner of his clothes, he had already appeared in front of Zhang Chongfeng and hit Zhang Chongfeng's chest hard with his elbow.
"Crack!"
The crisp sound of broken ribs was clearly audible. Zhang Gongfeng spat out a mouthful of blood, and his body flew out like a kite with broken strings. He hit the wall and then fell to the ground. He twitched twice and lost his breath.
